body.p: The Applicant appreciates the Examiner's thorough examination of the subject application.

The Applicant appreciates and thanks the Examiner for indicating claims 13, 25, 26, and 39 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all the features of the base claim and any intervening claims.

In response, the Applicant has amended independent claim 1 to include the features of claims 13, 12, and 6 and corresponding independent method claim 27 to include the features of claims 39, 38, and 32. The Applicant believes intervening 7, 33, and 37 qualify as intended use and need not be included in independent claims 1 and 27.
Accordingly, the Applicant believes the application is now in condition for allowance.

Each of the Examiner's rejections has been addressed or traversed. It is respectfully submitted that the application is in condition for allowance. Early and favorable action is respectfully requested.

If for any reason this Response is found to be incomplete, or if at any time it appears that a telephone conference with counsel would help advance prosecution, please telephone the undersigned or his associates, collect in Peabody, Massachusetts at (781) 890-5678.
